d: We are currently seeking a passionate and dynamic Sales Executive to focus on our Residences business, specifically managing long-stay guests and long-term accommodation enquiries. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving occupancy and revenue for Beach Rotana Residences by building relationships with all clients under such segment.

As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for implementing all sales activities and maximizing business opportunities within your designated market segment under the guidance and supervision of the Director of Sales. The role involves generating and maintaining business through proactive sales efforts, including face-to-face meetings, client presentations, telephone calls, and networking activities.
q: You should hold preferably a degree in sales marketing and minimum two years post graduate work experience in a similar position. Good computer skills and a perfect command of English is required.
The ideal candidate will be a vibrant and innovative individual.

You will be able to work independently and promote at all times the brand image and market status, as well as maintain accurate documentation and accounts record on all clients assigned, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: li
Handle all long-term accommodation enquiries for Beach Rotana Residences, from initial inquiry through to contract completion and move-in coordination.
li
Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, government organizations, relocation agencies, and individual guests seeking extended-stay accommodation.
li
Promote and sell long-stay and residential accommodation solutions to achieve occupancy and revenue targets.
li
Maintain a high level of market presence through direct sales activities and client visits.
li
Ensure comprehensive coverage of assigned accounts and market segments, building relationships at all levels of client organizations.
li
Implement and execute sales action plans to achieve and exceed established targets.
li
Negotiate rates, contracts, and long-term accommodation agreements in line with the property's sales strategy.
li
Identify and maximize upselling opportunities whenever possible.
li
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beach Rotana Residences' facilities, apartment types, services, amenities, and unique selling points.
li
Prepare proposals, corporate offers, lease agreements, and other business correspondence as required.
li
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs, providing regular feedback and recommendations to management.
li
Ensure exceptional customer service throughout the guest journey, fostering long-term relationships and repeat business

d: SANY has been present in Middle- East market since 2004 and has built a strong regional presence supporting customers across multiple countries and regions. Our Oman operations provide equipment, service, and spare parts solutions, supported by an extensive service and parts network.
At SANY, we are committed to supporting our customers through reliable equipment, strong partnerships, and comprehensive service solutions.
q: We are looking for a driven and customer-focused Spare Parts Sales Specialist to join our team in Oman.
This is a field-based sales role for someone who enjoys meeting customers, building relationships, identifying business opportunities, and driving sales growth.
If you have experience selling spare parts or working within the heavy equipment, machinery, or related industry, we'd love to hear from you.
Minimum 3 years of sales experience in spare parts, heavy equipment, machinery, or a related industry.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Experience in field sales and managing customer relationships.
A valid Oman Driving License – mandatory .
Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a field-based role.
r: li
Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
li
Conduct regular field and customer visits across the Oman.
li
Identify new business opportunities and drive spare parts sales.
li
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable spare parts solutions.
li
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
li
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth order processing and customer support.
li
Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
x: Opportunity to work with a growing and dynamic team.
Exposure to the heavy equipment and machinery industry.
A role where you can directly contribute to business growth and build strong industry relationships.
